참조: [Data Visualization with ggplot2::Cheat Sheet "Geoms" 'One Variable'](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/data-visualization.html#one-variable---continuous)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(ggplot2)
c <- ggplot(mpg, aes(hwy))
c2 <- ggplot(mpg)
d <- ggplot(mpg, aes(fl))
```
:::


#### 단일 변수(연속)

##### 면적: geom_area()

- 면적 그래프 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, y, alpha, color, fill, linetype, linewidth


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
c + geom_area(stat = "bin")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.
```


:::

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-2-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


##### 밀도: geom_density()

- 커널 밀도 통계량을 계산하고 커널 밀도 그래프 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, y, alpha, color, fill, group, linetype, linewidth, weight


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
c + geom_density(kernel = "gaussian")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


##### geom_dotplot()

- 점 그래프 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, y, alpha, color, fill


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
c + geom_dotplot()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
Bin width defaults to 1/30 of the range of the data. Pick better value with
`binwidth`.
```


:::

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


##### geom_freqpoly()

- 도수분포 다각형 그래프 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, y, alpha, color, group, linetype, linewidth


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
c + geom_freqpoly()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
`stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.
```


:::

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


##### 히스토그램: geom_histogram()

- 히스토그램 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, y, alpha, color, fill, linetype, linewidth, weight


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
c + geom_histogram(binwidth = 5)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


#### geon_qq()

- Q-Q 플롯 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, y, alpha, color, fill, linetype, size, weight


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
c2 + geom_qq(aes(sample = hwy))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



#### 단일 변수(이산)

##### 막대: geom_bar()

- 막대 그래프 그리는 함수
- aes() 인자: x, alpha, color, fill, linetype, linewidth, weight


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
d + geom_bar()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](ggplot2-1var_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::
